title: Pascal Cofactors
summary: A Lean 4 formalisation of p-adic valuation laws for alternating cofactors C_d(p^a) = (p^(ad)+1)/(p^a+1) with odd d. It proves finite-window coefficient scaling and an exact pre-extremal restricted-binomial-gcd formula, identifies the sparse endpoint, proves the least extremal row T_p(C_d(p^a)) = p^(ad)+1 for odd d >= 5, and gives the full cubic classification for p^(2a)-p^a+1. The Palomar Challenge records coefficient scaling, the exact bounded gcd formula, the odd-degree least-row theorem, and the cubic classification.

review.reason: Lean formalization of p-adic valuation laws for alternating cofactors.
